mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strengthening demand, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous two months signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous month signals increased economic output, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combined effect of high interest rates and inflationary pressure leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the previous month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the previous month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3 percentage points, the combined effect signals a strong labor market, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k and UNRATE decrease > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in GDP (GDPC1) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
